attrs.evidence: scripts/check-gate-import-closure.mjs reads the head receipt’s gates_run, resolves 19 distinct executables from 22 advertised commands, walks their transitive relative-import closure to 24 paths, and checks containment in the 85-path canonical set factory-scope.mjs derives over eleven derivations. A negative control confirms an invented root contributes nothing, so a walker returning everything cannot pass for this. IMPORTED FROM INV-R7.5 AND RE-ADJUDICATED, NOT INHERITED: the source lane carried PROVED and this lane carries CONDITIONAL, because the closure is static and the antecedent ASM-STATIC-IMPORT-CLOSURE is undischarged. Choosing the target status independently of the source status is the whole point of the import mechanism, and INV-R9 had instead disposed of this candidate as `already_present` under a canonical claim that is DECLARED — discarding a PROVED source result in favour of a weaker target proposition.

attrs.gap: THE WALKER IS THE SAME ONE THAT BUILDS THE CANONICAL SET. If it under-approximates, both sides of the containment move together and this check cannot see it; what is independent is the containment question, not the closure computation. Second, the antecedent: a computed dynamic import is invisible to a static walk, and this does not look for one — it says what it did not look at. Third, `gates_run` is a list in a receipt, so the proposition is about what the receipt CLAIMS to have run; FAC-RECEIPT-DECISIVE, which would make a receipt the thing that runs them, is open.
attrs.prior_art: INV-R7.5’s own record of the same proposition, carried as PROVED on that lane. GPT-5.6’s INV-R9.2 audit §5 ruled the already_present disposition inadmissible and proposed exactly this repair.

attrs.review_focus: Is CONDITIONAL the honest status, or is naming an antecedent nobody can discharge just PROVED with a disclaimer attached? The test would be whether anything in this artifact behaves differently because of the antecedent.
attrs.statement: The static transitive relative-import closure of every executable a transition receipt names in `gates_run` is contained in the receipt-bound canonical set: a module a gate imports is a path the receipt binds.
